findings.evidence: Heading level jumped from 2 (Open the test console) to 4 (Check the sidebar updated) with no intermediate level between them.
findings.fix: Insert a level 3 heading between Open the test console and Check the sidebar updated, or promote Check the sidebar updated to level 3.
findings.location: the Check the sidebar updated heading
findings.violation: This heading is nested more than one level deeper than the heading immediately before it, so a reader or a tool relying on heading level cannot reconstruct which section this one belongs under.

findings.evidence: The sentence 'The status indicator takes a few seconds to update while the delivery pipeline processes the event in the background.' appears after the action 'Click Trigger sample alert and wait for the status indicator to change to Sent.' This explanatory aside breaks the flow of the action sequence before the learner reaches the delivery log check in the final step.
findings.fix: Move the explanatory sentence about the status indicator delay to a separate explanation page, or include it only after the learner has completed all steps and seen the final result in the delivery log.
findings.location: the paragraph after 'Trigger the sample alert' heading
findings.violation: The tutorial pauses the action sequence to explain why the status indicator takes time to update, rather than keeping the learner performing the concrete guided sequence straight through to the visible result.
